itemDisplayName: AI Gateway tier (preview) ai-gateway-tier: hub + spoke connection for the Foundry golden path
description: AI Gateway tier (preview) hub-and-spoke module for the Microsoft Foundry golden path. main.bicep deploys a centralized AI Gateway tier (Azure API Management AIGateway SKU, 2025-09-01-preview) that fronts a Foundry model over managed identity, with a token-limit policy and a runtime key; connection.bicep attaches a consumer (spoke) project to it with an 'Admin-connected models' ModelGateway + ApiKey connection, in the same subscription or cross-subscription. An agent then references the model as <connectionName>/<modelName> via the Responses API. Release-gated preview: deploys where the AIGateway SKU is enabled (East US 2, Sweden Central).
summary: Hub-and-spoke AI Gateway tier module for the golden path. main.bicep = Foundry account + hub project + gpt-5.4 model + AIGateway service + managed-identity provider + token-limit policy + runtime key. connection.bicep = ModelGateway ApiKey connection on an existing spoke project pointed at the hub gateway; an agent consumes it as <connectionName>/<modelName> via the Responses API.
